subject: Claude: nest cover now uses phase-start beams (engine); Roost direct+alcove plans win
body:
# Claude overnight 4 October 2026

Session: scheduled `overnight handoff notes polling` (Claude). State: IN_PROGRESS.

## Claims (mailbox claim UNEQUAL-CROSSING-20261004)
New files only: `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.js`, `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.test.js`, this report. No shared topology/index/runtime-bank/active-file edits.

## Log
- Read handoff, scrum packet and mailbox; acknowledged scrum message 1791142576367-9283d02a0be4.
- Unequal Crossing generator written (see below).

## Unequal Crossing generator packet (batch 1): READY_FOR_REVIEW
Files: `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.js`, `unequal-crossing.test.js`. Not wired into `generation/index.js`, topology, runtime-bank or any bank; nothing is enabled and no candidate is certified (`certified:false`).

Interface (for Codex coding/bank work):
- `generateUnequalPuzzle({tier,seed,controlHex})` -> `{status,puzzle,mathematicalEvidence,puzzleFingerprint}`
- `generateUnequalCrossingCandidate({tier,seed,layoutId})` -> full schema-valid blueprint (`familyId:'unequal-crossing'`, `puzzle.kind:'balance'`, outputs `balance-crossing` (on-commit passage) and `reserve-benefit` (phase-start), hazard `scale-drain` mutation `puzzle`, commission `{poweredIds:['balance-crossing']}`).
- `unequalCrossingOutputs()`.

Rules implemented (spec section 6): six loads values 1..12; solution-first partitions with exact usedCount/reserveCount (T1 6; T2 4 or 5; T3-5 4..6); target = pan capacity; T1 maxPanCount 4 each, no pairs; T2-5 one or two incompatible pairs drawn from loads on different solution pans, each proven to remove at least one otherwise-valid partition; T3-5 exactly one hidden load, in the final allocation, with 3/4/5 candidates and allowance 2/3/3; every attempt enumerates all 3^6 allocations, requires the generated solution among them, counts mirror-reduced partitions (left/right symmetry not double counted), rejects hidden states where fewer than 2 candidates admit any valid allocation (inferable by solvability alone), and requires `solveWeighing` to prove a decision tree within the allowance (tests also replay the tree for every candidate and show allowance-1 is not distinguishable at T4).

Evidence: `node --test expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.test.js` 6 pass. Independent 3^6 enumeration agrees with the production solver counts. Planner (C-08A) wins through the real reducer on real candidates: T2 seed1 Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax (683 states, 33 cmds), T3 seed1 and seed2 Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly (4837 / 521 states); T2 seed2 is unknown at 20000 states (not an impossibility claim). T1 and T5 seeds: some topology seeds return `unknown` `unequal-crossing-invalid` (crossing-exit invariant), same attrition mechanism as Four Locks.

Decisions I made that Sam/scrum may override:
1. Reserve-benefit shield targets are `['shape','sustain']` (the two physical scale stations per spec section 6). Earlier engine test fixture used number+shape.
2. Pan capacity equals the target (any larger cap is unreachable because both pans must total the target exactly).
3. T1 cap-binding is not required: the spec reference weights [1,2,3,4,5,7] target 11 do not bind a cap of 4 either; recorded as evidence only.

Still open (not done): two-target-band-team plus alcove-route certification per candidate, bank construction/diversity certification, topology/tier registration, runtime-bank wiring, tiers' enemy/stat tuning beyond Four Locks defaults, UI beyond Codex's BalancePanel.

## Next
Remaining Claude queue: planner two-team validation of Unequal candidates; Turning Ravine tiers 2-5 (legacy released the files); other family packets; final-build lock work when Codex UI/art inputs are stable.

## Batch 2 (20:0x UTC): engine fix + Turning Ravine T2: READY_FOR_REVIEW
- Engine: `rules.js` computeOutputsFor powers `reserve-benefit` outputs from a valid allocation without selection (answers Codex CODE ABI check). Test in `integration-extra.test.js`. Engine/phase/integration suites pass (33).
- Turning Ravine T2 in `generation/turning-ravine.js` (claim RAVINE-GEN-20261004): 7 variable wheels (4 number, 3 operator O/E/P), 3 tracks, >=2 shared numbers, three templates (one shares the equals wheel), exact BigInt-style independent check in tests, exactly one full solution proven exhaustively, initial scramble >=half wheels and <=1 true track. River and hedges lay out; islands/terraces still fail footprint/topology exactly as T1 (unchanged, not relaxed).
- Planner through the real reducer: river seeds 1-3 and hedges seed 1 succeed for both direct-guard (Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax) and alcove-intercept (Cornix/Warden/Beeswax), 30-33 commands, 321-1010 states; replay hashes match. Tests: `node --test expeditions/v2/generation/turning-ravine.test.js` 8 pass.
- Not certified, not wired into runtime selection; T3-5 Ravine still pending.

## Batch 3: Turning Ravine T3: READY_FOR_REVIEW (claim RAVINE-GEN-20261004, released)
`generation/turning-ravine.js` now has a tier table (T2, T3) over one generic tiered generator. T3: 8 variable wheels (5 number, 3 operator), 4 tracks, shared B/C/D, a solved exact-division track (C ÷ D), one proven full solution, maxActive 3 of 4 (eq1..eq4), commission poweredCount 3. Mission-subset check: every 3-of-4 track subset is solved on its own wheels; require >=2 useful configurations and >=1 differing from the full solution (recorded as `usefulConfigurations`/`usefulDifferingFromFull`). Placement node budget raised to 600000 for T3 (50000 stays for T1/T2). River seeds 2,3 and hedges 2,3 build; islands/terraces and some seeds stay unknown exactly as before. Planner: Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly direct-guard wins on all four (645-1008 states, 31-33 commands, replay hashes match). Alcove-intercept: unsatisfiable `stat-infeasible` for both Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly and Cornix/Warden/Beeswax at T3, so the extra higher-band alcove proof needs another squad: Codex C-08B should pick it using `feasibleJobAssignments` (open). Tests: `turning-ravine.test.js` 10 pass.
Open: Ravine T4 (9 wheels, one 7-token parenthesised track), T5 (9 wheels, 5 tracks, two long tracks, active budget 3, two hazard sites); enemy roster per Ravine tier is still the T1 single rewinder (spec section 9 not yet applied).

## Batch 4: Turning Ravine T4: READY_FOR_REVIEW
T4 (hedges layout only; river/islands/terraces fail the 22-hex footprint, hedges seeds 2,3 build; seed 1 topology unknown): 9 wheels (5 number, 4 operator O/P/E/Q), 4 tracks incl. one 7-token left-associated track `(A O B) P C = t`, exact-division plate, shared B/C/D (+ shared equals plate/E variants to fit the footprint), one proven full solution (about 56k solver nodes), >=2 useful 3-of-4 configurations. Spec team examples through the real reducer: direct Barrow/Cobweb/Harvestmoon wins both seeds (622 and 625 states, 31 commands); alcove Warden/Longshadow/Cascade wins both (700 and 691 states, 32 commands); the opposite plan/team pairings are `stat-infeasible`. T3 alternate team Barrow/Driftwood/Gable: direct wins; no alcove-capable squad found yet at T3 (stat-infeasible for all tried). Test added; turning-ravine.test.js 11 pass.
Open: Ravine T5 (five tracks, two 7-token, active budget 3, two hazard sites) does not fit the 4..8 x 2..6 patch without heavier sharing: not attempted yet; per-tier Ravine enemy roster still T1's single rewinder.

## Batch 5: Maybe-Flock Roost generator T1-5: READY_FOR_REVIEW (not wired, not certified)
Files: `expeditions/v2/generation/maybe-flock.js`, `maybe-flock.test.js` (3 pass). `generateMaybeFlockCandidate({tier,seed,layoutId})`, `generateFlockPuzzle`, `maybeFlockOutputs`.
- Puzzle: 5x5, 8-16 filled, each sector (rows 0-1 north, 2 east, 3-4 south) has a filled cell, tier split-run/degenerate-line rules, unique solution proven by the production solver AND an independent row-bitmask counter in the test, human-solvable by pure line intersection; depth is measured as parallel propagation rounds (min 2/3/4/4/5 for T1-5; a cell forced in round n only feeds round n+1) plus multi-candidate-step counts for T4/5. T1 prints one given, always an EMPTY cell so it can never be jam-eligible (see the givens ruling).
- Blueprint: 3 perches (nearest eligible floor to (9,1),(10,4),(9,7), relocated off deployment/stations), `puzzle.perches`, nest lock groups anchored at the perch hex, `nests` per sector, beam outputs (selectable pair), commission poweredCount 2, sector enemies per spec section 7 (T1 Hunter east wake 2; T2 + Jammer north wake 2; T3 + Breaker south; T4/5 all wake 1), hazard `roost-drain` puzzle mutation. Roost has no passage output, so topology crossings are made permanent (passageOutputId stripped) after the exit-usability check.
- Reducer proof: ALCOVE plans win and replay: T1 Tuppence/Dapple/Sorrel (525 states, 33 cmds), T2 Cornix/Warden/Beeswax (11617 states, 32 cmds). Direct-guard plans are UNKNOWN at up to 200000 states (T1 Bushel/Furrow/Pip, T2 Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax): the planner's macro set does not express sector-beam defence well, so no second target-band direct plan yet; this is not an impossibility claim. Needs planner macros for beam-sector choice and engaging sector enemies (my C-08A file) before any Roost bank can be certified.

## Batch 6: Hollow Bough generator T1-5: READY_FOR_REVIEW (not wired, not certified)
Files: `expeditions/v2/generation/hollow-bough.js`, `hollow-bough.test.js` (3 pass). `generateHollowBoughCandidate({tier,seed,layoutId})`, `generateBoughPuzzle`, `hollowBoughOutputs`.
Radius-2 19-cell patch from the packing topology (all four layouts build at T1/T3/T5 seed 1; river T3 seed 1 hits the crossing-exit check), piece sizes/sockets/forbidden/forecast/reflection exactly per the section 8 table, pre-placed legal packing, >=2 legal packings with different covered and exposed cells (solver bounded at 24 packings), forecast = ascending socket IDs, T4/5 `suppress-shelter` hazard on group `patch`, T1-3 integrity-only. Roster as Four Locks (spec has no Bough override). Roost-style permanent crossings (no passage output).
Reducer proof (planner): T1 river direct Bushel/Furrow/Pip (21602 states) and alcove Tuppence/Dapple/Sorrel (669); T2 direct Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax and alcove Cornix/Warden/Beeswax; T3 islands direct Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly; T5 river direct and alcove Warden/Gossamer/Harvestmoon, all replay-verified. `npm test`: All 25 steps passed (08:10 BST 5 Oct).

## Batch 7 (5 Oct): engine fix, nest cover uses the phase-start beam snapshot; Roost direct plans now win
Root cause of "Roost direct plans unknown": `enemy.js` resolved nest damage using beams powered AFTER the environment hazard had already erased a pattern cell, so a committed beam covering a sector stopped covering it mid-phase and every nest hit the orchard (T1: 20 -> 11 in the first phase with both beams active). Fix (rules call, consistent with the spec's "sector grouping comes from the committed solved pattern before disruption" and the phase-start beam suppression): the nest loop now reads `phaseEffects.suppressedSectors`, the beams that fired at phase start. Test added in `integration-extra.test.js` (a mutation cannot uncover a covered nest; only the uncovered south sector is damaged). No certified Four Locks record uses nests, so historical certificates are unaffected. Phase/phase2/integration suites pass (28).
Roost through the real reducer after the fix: direct T1 Bushel/Furrow/Pip (532 states), T2 Cornix/Warden/Beeswax (235), T3 Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly (12965), T4 Barrow/Cobweb/Harvestmoon (1800); alcove T1 Tuppence/Dapple/Sorrel, T1 seed2 Bushel/Dapple/Pip, T2 Cornix/Warden/Beeswax. T1 seed1 now has two different target-band teams on two physical routes. T2 Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax direct and T1 seed 2 Bushel/Furrow/Pip direct remain unknown at 30000 states. `maybe-flock.test.js` updated (5 reducer wins). `npm test`: All 25 steps passed.
